198:     source: ObservationSnapshot, current: ObservationSnapshot, element_id: str
199: ) -> ElementRef:
200:     """Return a unique compatible current candidate, or refuse without coordinates.
201: 
202:     The small offset search accommodates a contour boundary shifting by up to two
203:     pixels. It searches only actual current candidates, and both target pixels and
204:     surrounding context must agree; no old location is accepted as a fallback.
205:     """
206:     validate_frames(source, current)
207:     element = source.element(element_id)
208:     if element is None:
209:         raise GroundingError(f"candidate {element_id!r} is absent from its source frame")
210:     if not _candidate_is_valid(element, source):
211:         raise GroundingError("source candidate is outside foreground or has invalid geometry")
212:     old_image = _load_image(source)
213:     new_image = _load_image(current)
214:     box = element.bounding_box
215:     assert source.window_bounds is not None
216:     crop = BoundingBox(
217:         left=max(0, source.window_bounds.left, box.left - _PADDING),
218:         top=max(0, source.window_bounds.top, box.top - _PADDING),
219:         right=min(old_image.shape[1], source.window_bounds.right, box.right + _PADDING),
220:         bottom=min(old_image.shape[0], source.window_bounds.bottom, box.bottom + _PADDING),
221:     )
222:     template = old_image[crop.top:crop.bottom, crop.left:crop.right]
223:     target = old_image[box.top:box.bottom, box.left:box.right]
224:     gray = cv2.cvtColor(target, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
225:     if float(gray.std()) < _MIN_TEXTURE_STD or np.count_nonzero(
226:         cv2.Canny(gray, 40, 120)
227:     ) < _MIN_EDGE_PIXELS:
228:         # Constant patches can yield perfect normalized correlation everywhere.
229:         # A border and context alone must not manufacture identity for blank data.
230:         raise GroundingError("source candidate has insufficient visual texture")
231:     source_matches = _score_candidates(element, crop, template, old_image, source)
232:     if len(source_matches) > 1 and source_matches[0][0] - source_matches[1][0] < _MIN_MARGIN:
233:         # If one of two identical old controls disappears, the surviving clone
234:         # must not inherit the selected one's identity merely because it is alone.
235:         raise GroundingError("source candidate is visually ambiguous")
236:     matches = _score_candidates(element, crop, template, new_image, current)
237:     if not matches or matches[0][0] < _MIN_CORRELATION or not matches[0][1]:
238:         raise GroundingError("source candidate disappeared or its appearance changed")
239:     if len(matches) > 1 and matches[0][0] - matches[1][0] < _MIN_MARGIN:
240:         raise GroundingError("multiple current candidates are visually ambiguous")
241:     return matches[0][2]

recommended_design_not_implemented.preferred: Reject conflicting nonempty target_text and explicit element_id before input; preserve native plan and return a bounded replan error, rather than silently selecting the text target.
recommended_design_not_implemented.source_and_fresh_checks: Validate the original selected candidate against supplied visible text in the planning frame, then validate again after pixel refresh in the fresh dispatch frame. Pixel identity proves the same control, not that the original control matches the intended text.
recommended_design_not_implemented.labeled_candidate: A labeled candidate must be consistent with the supplied text under an explicitly defined existing text-match rule; an explicit ID may legitimately disambiguate repeated equal labels.
recommended_design_not_implemented.anonymous_candidate: When supplied text matches detected visible text, require matching OCR evidence spatially contained by the chosen contour and reject if the contour contains a different competing label while the requested text is elsewhere. Blank target_text/true anonymous controls need their existing visual grounding path; do not invent labels.
recommended_design_not_implemented.ambiguity: If text-to-candidate consistency cannot be established, fail closed/replan. Do not automatically change the model's ID to another control merely because that control has a unique label.
compatibility_tests_needed: Wrong anonymous ID plus unique target text outside its contour causes zero dispatch and retains raw mismatch.
Matching text inside its actual contour remains allowed.
Same-label multiple controls can be disambiguated only by consistent explicit ID.
Labeled candidate with contradictory supplied text is rejected.
Stale ID refresh cannot bypass source/fresh consistency.
ID-only anonymous visual controls retain their explicitly supported path.
All shared budgets, raw receipts and no unknown replay remain unchanged.
recommended_design_not_implemented.not_claimed: Containment/text consistency is a guard against observable cross-field conflicts, not proof of widget role, caller semantics or arbitrary GUI safety. Any new policy requires separate authorization, targeted tests and a new freeze.
